language.intro: This region is multilingual — most people move between two or three of these depending on who they're talking to. Tap a language below to see its everyday phrases.
language.phrasesIntro: A handful of local phrases go a long way — here are the essentials.

spoken.name: Hindi
spoken.note: Understood almost everywhere; safest default for signage and basic conversation.

spoken.name: Punjabi
spoken.note: The everyday language in homes, markets, and local media across this region.

spoken.name: English
spoken.note: Common in official signage, businesses, and with younger people in urban areas — usually blended with local words in casual speech.

festivals.intro: Festivals shape the rhythm of local life — plan around them, or better, join in.

items.name: Diwali
items.description: Festival of lights, marked by lamps, fireworks and family gatherings.

items.name: Holi
items.description: The color festival — streets fill with color powder and music.

items.name: Local Harvest Fair
items.description: A community celebration of the season's harvest with food stalls and folk performances.

lifestyle.intro: How locals actually spend their day.
notes: Mornings often start early with tea/coffee at a neighborhood stall.
Markets are busiest in the early evening after the day's heat eases.
Most shops close for a short afternoon break in smaller neighborhoods.
